name: PNB 5104
title: Clinical Practicum in Intraoperative Neuromonitoring
description: Direct student involvement in intraoperative neuromonitoring of various surgical procedures, observing live signals obtained in a clinical setting, interaction with patients, surgeons and operating room staff, and review of operating room protocols and procedures. May be repeated for a total of 12 credits.
requirement_description: PNB 5101, 5102 and 5103 with an average GPA of 3.0 or higher in these classes, and instructor consent.
